basic_details.job_title: NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Technology Warangal has one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post open for 3 years. The post is in the ANRF-sponsored project "Utilization of Cerium Oxide Derived from Critical Mineral Waste for Development of Multifunctional Insulation Coatings". The pay is ₹37,000/month for the first 2 years and ₹42,000/month from the 3rd year, with HRA as per institute rules. You need a B.E./B.Tech with an ME/M.Tech, an M.Sc., or an M.Tech in the subjects the notice lists. To apply, email the completed application form and your resume to [email protected] and [email protected] by 30 Oc

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form on page 3 of the notice ("Application for the Position of JRF Position under MAHA-EV-ANRF Project"). It asks for: name, father's name, date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY), sex, marital status and category (OC/OBC/SC/ST).

In the same form, give your educational qualifications for SSC, Intermediate, B.Sc./B.E./B.Tech and M.Sc./M.Tech. For each one, add the specialization, board/university, year of passing, class and percentage/CGPA.
Add any GATE/NET/ICMR/DBT-SRF score you have, with the year you appeared and your All India rank.

List your research, industrial or teaching experience, giving the organisation, the dates of joining and leaving, and the length of the experience. Then add your publications and conference participation, any other relevant information, and your contact email and phone number.

Sign and date the declaration. It confirms that your statements are true and that you are available for an ONLINE interview if needed. If any information is found false or incorrect, or you are found ineligible before or after selection, your candidature is liable to be cancelled.
Attach a brief resume/curriculum vitae/bio-data to the form.
Email the form and your resume to [email protected] and [email protected] with the subject line: Application for JRF position ANRF project (Coatings). Send it by 30 October 2026.
Prof. Shirish H. Sonawane, Principal Investigator: 8702462626, [email protected]
Prof. Anjana P A, Co-Principal Investigator, Department of Chemical Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Warangal, Telangana State, India: +91-870-2462611, [email protected]

content_sections.text: The notice accepts any one of these three options: B.E./ B. Tech equivalent degree in Chemical Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Biotech/Civil/Metallurgy /Polymer engineering and ME/M. Tech/ in Chemical Engineering / Mechanical / Energy Engineering / Nanotechnology / Biotech/Civil/Environmental Engineering with CGPA above 8 Or M.Sc. in Chemistry/Physics/ Materials Science/ Nanoscience and Nanotechnology or equivalent Or M. Tech. in Engineering with materials related specialization such as Materials Science/ Metallurgy/ Nanoscience and Nanotechnology/ Ceramic Engineering/ Surface Engineering or equivalent with minimum of 60% aggregate marks or 6.5 CGPA at both UG and PG (wherever applicable) Candidates who have qualified GATE/NET will be given preference. Candidates without GATE or NET need to appear in the National Level Examination conducted by the Institute for Ph.D. admission. Experience in functional coatings will be preferred. The notice wants candidates with experience in material synthesis, water treatment, functional coatings related areas, with knowledge in characterization and analysis. The notice prints the age limit as "JRF – 30". It does not say on which date age is counted. For the exact discipline-specific eligibility of the post, check the official notification. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form on page 3 of the notice ("Application for the Position of JRF Position under MAHA-EV-ANRF Project"). It asks for: name, father's name, date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY), sex, marital status and category (OC/OBC/SC/ST). In the same form, give your educational qualifications for SSC, Intermediate, B.Sc./B.E./B.Tech and M.Sc./M.Tech. For each one, add the specialization, board/university, year of passing, class and percentage/CGPA. Add any GATE/NET/ICMR/DBT-SRF score you have, with the year you appeared and your All India rank. List your research, industrial or teaching experience, giving the organisation, the dates of joining and leaving, and the length of the experience. Then add your publications and conference participation, any other relevant information, and your contact email and phone number. Sign and date the declaration. It confirms that your statements are true and that you are available for an ONLINE interview if needed. If any information is found false or incorrect, or you are found ineligible before or after selection, your candidature is liable to be cancelled. Attach a brief resume/curriculum vitae/bio-data to the form. Email the form and your resume to [email protected] and [email protected] with the subject line: Application for JRF position ANRF project (Coatings) . Send it by 30 October 2026. Prof. Shirish H. Sonawane, Principal Investigator: 8702462626, [email protected] Prof. Anjana P A, Co-Principal Investigator, Department of Chemical Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Warangal, Telangana State, India: +91-870-2462611, [email protected]

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The list of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website. Candidates will also be told by email or phone. The shortlisted candidate will have to attend an interview, which may be ONLINE or OFFLINE. For an online interview, candidates are expected to have a good internet connection. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the NIT Warangal JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the ANRF-sponsored project of the Department of Chemical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 30 October 2026, and you apply by email.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: You need one of three options. The first is a B.E./B.Tech in a listed engineering branch plus an ME/M.Tech in a listed field, with CGPA above 8. The second is an M.Sc. in Chemistry/Physics/Materials Science/Nanoscience and Nanotechnology or equivalent. The third is an M.Tech in a materials-related specialization with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks or 6.5 CGPA at both UG and PG (wherever applicable).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: The notice prints the age limit as "JRF – 30". SC/ST/OBC/Women and Physically handicapped candidates can get a relaxation of up to 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Warangal JRF?
faq.answer: The pay is ₹37,000/month for the first 2 years and ₹42,000/month from the 3rd year, with HRA as per institute rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: Email the completed application form and a brief resume to [email protected] and [email protected] by 30 October 2026. Use the subject line "Application for JRF position ANRF project (Coatings)".

faq.question: Q7. How will the NIT Warangal JRF be selected?
faq.answer: The list of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website and shared by email or phone. The shortlisted candidate will then attend an interview, online or offline. No TA/DA is paid for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is GATE or NET compulsory for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: No, but GATE/NET-qualified candidates will be given preference. Candidates without GATE or NET need to appear in the National Level Examination conducted by the Institute for Ph.D. admission.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NIT Warangal JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and lasts 3 years under the ANRF-sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q10. Can the NIT Warangal JRF register for a PhD?
faq.answer: Yes. The selected candidate may register for a PhD as per institute rules, but must apply for a PhD position when that advertisement is open.
